release_notes: Up Next: focus the progress bar to see what's coming, then press down to browse the queue and pick a song
Now Playing shows where your music comes from, like TIDAL or Apple Music, next to the audio quality
Remos opens on the room you used last, and you can hide rooms you don't play music on
Previous and next now work for songs started from Favorites and Jump Back In, and the progress bar can jump through a song

announcements.title: Up Next, your rooms and smoother playback
announcements.body: The queue now lives under the progress bar: focus the bar to see what's coming and press down to browse it or jump to any song. Now Playing also shows where your music comes from, like TIDAL, Apple Music or Spotify. Remos remembers the room you used last, and in System you can hide rooms you don't play music on. Previous and next now work for songs started from Favorites and Jump Back In, and you can move through a song with the progress bar. Thanks for all your feedback — most of this update came from it!

announcements.title: Remos now speaks your language
announcements.body: Remos Player is now available in English, Türkçe, Deutsch, Français, Español and Nederlands. It follows your TV's language — you can pick another one anytime in Settings › Language. This update also adds on-screen messages when something starts playing, joins the queue or is added to favorites, and makes the Back button work more naturally. Thanks for testing!

announcements.title: Welcome to the Remos Player beta
announcements.body: Thanks for testing Remos Player. Updates and news about the app will appear here.
